description:
Hi team,

We’re ready to roll out the Portworx service (framework name **portworx**) on our DC/OS cluster. The service will be identified as **portworx** and will listen on API port **9001**. Each of the three instances will run with **1.5 CPU shares** and **4096 MB of memory** per task, using the command‑line arguments **"-a"**. The container will reference system headers from **/lib/modules**, which is appropriate for our CoreOS nodes.

Please verify that the three instances are scheduled and that the framework registers correctly. Let me know if any adjustments are needed before we move to production.
